title: Nonsymmetric simplicial multicategories and simplicial multifunctors
statement: Use simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] and Kan complexes [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] in a fixed small universe. A nonsymmetric simplicial multicategory $P$ consists of a small set of colors, simplicial operation sets $P(c_1,\ldots,c_n;d)$ for every finite ordered input list, including $n=0$, unary unit vertices, and simplicial substitution maps $P(y_1,\ldots,y_m;z)\times\prod_{i=1}^m P(x_{i,1},\ldots,x_{i,k_i};y_i)\to P(x_{1,1},\ldots,x_{m,k_m};z)$. Substitution is associative for three ordered levels and has the unary units as left and right units. Locally Kan means that every operation set, including each nullary set, is Kan. A simplicial multifunctor is a color map together with simplicial maps on all operation sets preserving the unary units and substitution.
